SRBA Interior is looking for an enthusiastic and experienced Draftsman/Work Planner . 
About SRBA Interior 
SRBA Interior, a division of the SRBA Group, creates large-scale custom interiors for hotels, healthcare facilities, retail environments, and educational institutions, among others. With a strong combination of traditional craftsmanship and efficient production capacity, we have the flexibility to carry out both large-scale projects and unique, specialized custom solutions. From concept to completion, we work closely with clients, architects, and developers. 
Job Description 
At SRBA Interior, you'll work as a Production Planner/Drafter on challenging and prestigious interior design projects, such as those for The Sting, Costes, and the Cotton Club. You'll be responsible for preparing, developing, and creating technical drawings for custom interiors and furniture. 
With an eye for detail, you'll ensure that designs are translated into clear production drawings and practical solutions for the workshop and installation teams. You'll work closely with clients, architects, the workshop, and the installation department to ensure projects run smoothly. 
You'll be part of a close-knit and professional team where quality, precision, and collaboration are key. You'll ensure that every project is well-prepared and successfully brought from concept to finished product. 
We ask: - You are a skilled draftsman/work planner - You have an eye for quality and take pride in delivering high-quality, professional work - You have experience with technical drawing and/or work planning - You have experience with drafting software such as AutoCAD and Palette CAD - You have technical knowledge of materials, structures, and manufacturing processes - You are detail-oriented, solution-oriented, and skilled at planning and collaborating - You are fluent in English
